Dispersal and accessibility terms (Dg, Dr, A) by isotropic cost distance

Source: R/fn_cost.R
cost.Rd

The RankIndex distance terms, all on one terra-native, isotropic engine (no gdistance/raster): a friction surface plus costDist from a set of sources, tiled so large domains stay in memory.

Details

  • Dg - geographic distance from a known population: geo_distance (straight-line distance to the nearest source).

  • Dr - resistance distance: build_resistance friction -> cost_distance from occupied populations.

  • A - accessibility: tobler_friction (walking cost) -> cost_distance from the road/trail network.

All three return a surface rescaled to \([0, 1]\); because the index rewards short distance / easy access, pass invert = TRUE for the \(1 - \tilde d\) form the index consumes.

build_resistance() is lifted from safeHavens (buildResistanceSurface); the tiling (cluster_region_extents, mosaic-by-min) is lifted from the Ecoloradense cost-distance script. Both are terra/sf only - the lift adds no dependency beyond terra, sf.
